headline: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra finished a World of Warcraft starting zone without seeing the screen, by reading the game's raw network messages and building its own route-finding tool.
score_reason: Pool 5 lowered by 1: reported on 3 Oct, a game demonstration whose wider security meaning is the outlet's commentary.
importance_line: It shows an AI model writing its own tools and decoding an undocumented network protocol, which is relevant to security teams, though no attack on real systems has been shown.
summary: Startup Fortune reports, citing Tom's Hardware, that GPT-6 Astra cleared World of Warcraft's orc starting zone in about 40 minutes without dying, using the open-source agent-wow client on a private test server. The model read raw server messages and quest data instead of the screen and wrote its own pathfinding program; Startup Fortune notes that nobody has shown the model doing the same to a real corporate network.
